9357.d: Elder God Wars Dungeon, also known as God Wars Dungeon 3 and often abbreviated as EGWD or GWD3, is the third God Wars Dungeon, located within the ancient ruins of Senntisten.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Senntisten can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift.

Travel methods include:
 class="sortable wikitable align-center-4" 

! Method
! Destination
! Requirements
! Direct teleport | Archaeology journal | North of the Archaeology Guild, south of the ancient door entrance to Senntisten. | NA | No | Gnome glider | Lemanto Andra (3) close to the ancient door entrance to Senntisten. | The Grand Tree | No | Pontifex shadow ring | Senntisten Cathedral | City of Senntisten | Yes | Skeletal horror Teleport | Odd Old Man | Fur 'n' Seek Wish list | No | Dig sites map
rowspan: "3" | Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of Azzanadra's Cathedral. | 60 Archaeology | Yes | Archaeology teleport | NA 
class: "text-align-center" | No | Master archaeologist's outfit | 99 Archaeology
class: "text-align-center" | Yes | Dig Site pendant or Passage of the Abyss | Varrock Dig Site or Senntisten Temple | NA | No | Treasure chest (Elite Dungeons) | Pulley entrance to The Zamorakian Undercity just north of the TzekHaar Front | NA | Yes | Boss portal (War's Retreat)
rowspan: "2" | Any of the four fronts, outside the boss arena. | sc | combat | 60 combat level or sc | skill total level and at least 1 kill of the respective boss. | Yes | Boss portal (Max Guild) | Access to the Max Guild.
class: "text-align-center" | Yes

9427.d: Elf boys are male elf children found frolicking throughout the elven city of Prifddinas.

9428.d: The Elf Camp can be found in Tirannwn, the most western part of Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Partial completion of Regicide is required in order to access the Elf camp.
• Tirannwn quiver 3 teleport directly to the camp
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport. Run northwest through the forest. Turn west before the bridge leading up the hill to Prifddinas, then walk across the log balance to enter the camp (45 Agility).
• Same as above, but instead of heading west before the bridge, walk across the bridge and enter the Dense Forest just west of the hill up the hill to Prifddinas.

9431.d: The elf musician is a musician in Tirannwn, and a member of the Cadarn Clan.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
The elf musician is found very near the centre of the Isafdar forest. The nearest teleport options are: 
• Tirannwn lodestone
• Crystal teleport seed teleport to Lletya
• Tirannwn quiver 1 teleport to Lletya
One way to reach her, from Lletya, is to exit the Lletya gates, pass the Lletya strange trees to the west, pass the tripwire to the west, and go through the dense forest just west of that. Another way to reach her, from the Tirannwn lodestone, is to travel north-west, then pass the stick trap to the east. You will reach the central clearing, which contains a Hunter training area as well as the elf musician.
